summary: AI-powered web scraping has shifted from selector-based extraction to LLM-native pipelines that return clean markdown or structured JSON ready for RAG and agent workflows. Tools like Firecrawl and ScrapeGraphAI lead the AI-native category, while established browser automation frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium) increasingly integrate AI layers and cloud infrastructure providers like Browserbase and Apify scale these workloads. Developer adoption clusters around tools that minimize boilerplate and output data directly consumable by LLMs.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; costs only arise from hosting/cloud browser providers
ai_features: Integrates with AI agent frameworks for autonomous browsing
Works as execution layer for LLM-driven automation
Codegen and auto-wait reduce brittle selector logic
tools.best_for: Full browser automation and scraping JavaScript-heavy pages at scale

tools.name: Scrapy
tools.pricing_paid: Free open source; Zyte cloud services start around $0.10/1k requests
ai_features: Pairs with AI extraction add-ons and Zyte API auto-extract
strengths: Python default for static and medium-scale scraping
Highly extensible middleware and pipeline architecture

tools.name: Puppeteer
ai_features: Common execution backend for AI browser agents

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans start around $16/mo, scaling to $333+/mo for higher volume
ai_features: LLM-ready clean markdown and JSON output
Web-scale /monitor always-on search across the web
Handles JavaScript, crawling, and interaction in one API
strengths: AI-native output ideal for RAG and agents
Single API for crawl, scrape, and interaction
tools.best_for: Developers building agents or LLM pipelines needing clean, usable output

tools.name: Selenium
ai_features: Used as execution layer for AI-driven test and scraping agents

tools.best_for: Cross-language browser automation and legacy test suites

tools.name: Apify

tools.best_for: General-purpose scraping and automation with reusable actors

tools.name: Crawlee
